@graph.comment: Default no-op hook for MarkdownProjectionListener. Swapped for MemTriggerPostProjectionHook by mem-trigger.json Override when mem-trigger is installed.

MarkdownProjectionListener — subscribes to MonitoringStore 'changed' events, projects body wikilinks + frontmatter to .meta Turtle for every /wiki/*.md write (D58/D71/D72). Mirrors the MementoCommitListener wiring pattern. K1: the WorkerParallelInitializer Override that registers this listener lives in mem-trigger.json (single Override per instance — all three listeners enumerated there).

MarkdownBodyProjector — the text/markdown BodyProjector implementation injected into the AdmissionFloorStore (D108 Front-2). Projects a markdown body to its candidate .meta graph (project), and materializes the admitted graph + body-hash stamp into the resource's .meta in-band (materialize). Same baseUrl/dataDir/storagePath wiring as the listener above; it loads the ESM projection pipeline + MetaWriter at runtime (the floor stays profile-agnostic). Injected across bundles via the floor's wildcard projector range.
